Author: rebelmike
Content: So the idea was to make it super obvious which way around to put the die (assuming you can see the markings on the die).  This is what a run 2 die looks like.  You are allowed to remove the wafer space logo, but not the arrow in the top right or the QR code  in the bottom left:

Author: rebelmike
Content:
So things are now in the same position on the CoB and the die.  The arrow always matches, and the wafer space logo matches providing the user hasn't removed it.

Pin 1 is in the bottom left, and is indicated by QR code on the die and by the circle on the CoB.  I see there's potential for this to be confusing because the arrow and logo markings are a bit more obvious - but as everything is now the same way round as it is in klayout/OpenROAD it is hopefully unlikely that users would get confused.

Author: rebelmike
Content: That said - there's potential for making the arrow smaller and/or the pin 1 circle bigger, or having some other marking to make it more obvious.
